## Source

Name and address.

## What it adds

Countries and languages, and a rough song count.

## Access

The terms of use, what the site's robots file allows, and whether a bulk file exists. No request goes to a new site before Gabriel approves this issue.

## Kind

Bulk dump, whole-site archive, or live parser.

## Done when

1. The source has an entry in the catalog with its license and access decision.
2. The parser or importer has tests that use small fixtures.
